prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready HD 2D fighting-game stage background, FAR LAYER of a parallax set, fully opaque.
Input images: Image 1 is the master character reference of the game (Saint Louis): match its clean hand-drawn HD line art, fluid inked contours, flat cel-shaded shadows and discreet gradients exactly, at background scale. Image 2 is the game logo "Patate de Forain": use it only for the colour energy (warm yellow, orange, red, navy ink); do not draw the logo or any text.
Primary request: a wide panoramic background of a traditional French travelling funfair (fete foraine) at dusk, seen from inside the fairground, distant view. Contents: a large Ferris wheel with warm bulb lights left of centre, its top close to the top of the image; a red-and-cream striped big-top tent right of centre; a distant wooden roller-coaster silhouette; garlands of small bulb lights between tall poles; low rooftops and a church steeple of a small French town far behind; a few trees. Sky: dusk gradient from deep violet-indigo at the top to warm apricot-orange near the horizon, a few soft flat-shaded clouds, the first stars.
Layout: landscape, as wide as possible (at least 2:1; the final intended canvas is 2112 x 1000 pixels). The horizon / ground line lies at about 10% of the image height from the bottom; below it, a band of dark trodden ground in shadow. Spread the shapes across the whole width so the image can be cropped on either side. The lower 55% of the image (behind the fighters) must stay calm: low contrast, slightly hazy atmospheric perspective, muted desaturated purples, mauves and dusty teal; keep the brightest lights, the strongest contrast and most detail in the upper half.
Constraints: no characters, no people, no animals, no readable text, letters, numbers, signs or logos, no brand names, no UI, no frame or border, no watermark. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photorealistic. Avoid saturated royal blue and gold in the lower half of the image (the fighters wear these colours).
codexInstructions: Instructions for you (Codex): generate this image with your image generation tool, at the widest landscape size it supports. Save the final PNG exactly at <source> (create nothing else, modify no other file). Then print the pixel dimensions of the saved file. If the result is not landscape or contains text, regenerate once.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready HD 2D fighting-game stage layer, MIDDLE LAYER of a parallax set, on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
Input images: Image 1 is the far background layer of this same stage (dusk funfair): match its palette, light direction, horizon and rendering exactly; this middle layer will be drawn in front of it. Image 2 is the master character reference of the game (Saint Louis): match its clean hand-drawn HD line art, fluid inked contours, flat cel-shaded shadows and discreet gradients.
Primary request: a continuous row of traditional French funfair stalls standing along the back of the fairground alley at dusk, seen straight from the front: a shooting-gallery booth with a striped awning and rows of tin targets, a hook-a-duck stall with a little water trough, a sweets stall with jars and cotton-candy cones, a small vintage carousel with painted wooden horses partly visible, a high-striker strength tester with its tall tower and bell, wooden crates, barrels, hay bales, cast-iron lamp posts with warm bulbs. Awnings in muted crimson, cream and dusty teal stripes; dark weathered wood. All the stalls stand on one common straight ground line at the very bottom of the image.
Layout: landscape, as wide as possible (at least 2:1; the final intended canvas is 2688 x 800 pixels). The stalls fill the full width from edge to edge with no gap, so the strip can be cropped on either side. Their tops (awnings, roofs, lamp posts, the strength tester tower) reach between 35% and 60% of the image height with an irregular skyline; everything above them is fully transparent, so the far layer shows through. The lower part (behind the fighters' bodies) must stay calm and readable: medium-dark values, low contrast, muted desaturated colours, no bright spots or busy patterns at mid height; keep the warm bulb highlights on the awnings and lamp tops.
Constraints: no characters, no people, no animals, no readable text, letters, numbers, prices, signs or logos, no brand names, no UI, no frame, no ground plane in front of the stalls, no cast shadow on the ground, no checkerboard drawn in, no watermark. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photorealistic. No saturated royal blue and no gold (the fighters wear these colours).
codexInstructions: Instructions for you (Codex): generate this image with your image generation tool, at the widest landscape size it supports. Ask for a true transparent background; afterwards check that the four corners and the area above the stalls are fully transparent (alpha 0); if the background came out opaque, remove it cleanly with a chroma-key or flood-fill pass and keep soft anti-aliased edges. Save the final PNG exactly at <source> (create nothing else, modify no other file). Then print the pixel dimensions and whether the file has an alpha channel. If the result is not landscape or contains text, regenerate once.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready HD 2D fighting-game stage layer, GROUND STRIP of a parallax set, fully opaque, seamlessly tileable horizontally.
Input images: Image 1 is the far background layer of this same stage (dusk funfair): match its palette and lighting. Image 2 is the master character reference of the game (Saint Louis): match its clean hand-drawn HD line art, fluid inked contours, flat cel-shaded shadows and discreet gradients.
Primary request: the walkable ground of a French funfair alley at dusk, seen from the side at a low grazing angle, as a long horizontal strip: trodden beige-brown earth mixed with old grey paving stones, a little sawdust, a few scattered paper confetti and flattened popcorn, faint warm light reflections from the stalls behind. The texture recedes slightly with perspective toward the top edge. Even density across the whole width, no single eye-catching object, no puddle, no hole.
Layout: very wide landscape strip (the final intended canvas is 2912 x 220 pixels, so make it as wide and flat as possible, at least 3:1). The left and right edges must join seamlessly when tiled. Values: medium-dark and low contrast so that fighters standing on it stay readable; slightly darker at the bottom edge.
Constraints: no characters, no people, no animals, no feet, no objects standing on the ground, no readable text, letters, numbers or logos, no UI, no frame or border, no watermark. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photorealistic. No saturated royal blue and no gold.
